# cad-cli company-template

<!-- Generated from the command definitions by `mise run docs:cli`. Do not edit. -->

Inspect reusable company templates available to the current API key.

```console
cad-cli company-template [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`list`](#cad-cli-company-template-list) | List reusable company templates accessible to the authenticated user |

Every command also accepts the [global options](README.md#global-options).

## cad-cli company-template list

List reusable company templates accessible to the authenticated user.

```console
cad-cli company-template list [OPTIONS]
```

### Examples

List the company templates the API key can access:

```console
cad-cli company-template list
```
